chunks: Said Moses to his people: "Invoke the help of God and be firm. The earth belongs to God: He can make whom He wills among His creatures inherit it. The future is theirs who take heed for themselves."
ai.seo_question: What did Moses tell his people about God's ownership of the earth and patience?
ai.summary: This verse, situated within the narrative of the Israelites' wilderness journey, underscores the theological principle of divine sovereignty over territorial inheritance, a concept central to Shia exegesis regarding the transition of authority from the unworthy to the righteous. It serves as a bridge between immediate patience (sabr) and the ultimate eschatological victory (al-‘aqibah) for the God-conscious (al-muttaqin).
